entities.summary: David Wolf is a German professional ice hockey player who currently plays for the EC Kassel Huskies of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga 2 (DEL). He played five seasons in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL) for the Hannover Scorpions and Hamburg Freezers between 2009 and 2014 before moving over to North America. Internationally, Wolf has represented Germany at both the junior and senior levels.
